snippet.description:
In this video, Sugandha Gupta (AIR 207, UPSC CSE 2025) shares an important lesson from her preparation: avoid the FOMO of collecting new resources, focus on revising what you have already studied, practise answer writing and stay consistent.

You don't need to follow every new source in the market. Master what you have, revise regularly and protect your mental peace.

Watch this short for practical UPSC preparation advice from a CSE 2025 achiever.

#UPSC #UPSCPreparation #SugandhaGupta #AIR207 #UPSCStrategy #UPSC2028 #LevelUpIAS #UPSCShorts
